title: A builder cannot edit a test-author path such as hooks/mutate_guard.py
why: Builder agents edited hooks/mutate_guard.py, a test-author path (AUTHOR_MUTATION_TESTS in hooks/guard.py), and reported no refusal (lane notes-fix-merge-ci, 17:51 CST Nov 7). Rule roles-one-role-per-agent.
note: The lane first checks whether main already refuses it, then writes red cases. Parked on owner page item 378 (mutate-guard-owner-unclear), 17:54 CST: main lets builders edit hooks/mutate_guard.py. c (recommended) lets builders add mutants only.
